description:
Site: crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/mod.rs:1

```
//! Typed JMAP Chat method wrappers — response types, Patch<T>, SessionClient,
```

`RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --workspace --no-deps` fails with:

```
error: unclosed HTML tag `T`
  --> crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/mod.rs:1:60
   |
 1 | //! Typed JMAP Chat method wrappers — response types, Patch<T>, SessionClient,
   |                                                            ^^^
   = note: `-D rustdoc::invalid-html-tags` implied by `-D warnings`
error: could not document `jmap-chat-client`
```

Rustdoc's invalid_html_tags lint treats single-uppercase-letter `<T>` as a not-closed HTML element. Fix: wrap in backticks — ``response types, `Patch<T>`, SessionClient,``. Line 96 inside the same file already backticks `Patch<T>` correctly, so this is one-line drift only on line 1.

Impact: publish-readiness — `cargo publish --dry-run` for jmap-chat-client succeeds today because publish doesn't run rustdoc with -D warnings, but the docs.rs build will fail with the same gate, and the CI `doc` job in .github/workflows/ci.yml already gates on this and will start failing on this crate.

Sibling check: `rg '^//[!/].*[A-Za-z]<[A-Za-z]' --type rust` shows other crate-doc strings reference `<Mutex>`, `<MailBackend>` etc.; rustdoc only flags the single-uppercase-letter `<T>` because multi-letter words are not HTML element names. So the fix is local — line 1 of crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/mod.rs only.

Why P1: `cargo doc --workspace -D warnings` was previously passing (JMAP-sc1b.5 closed 9 days ago). Regression. New since most recent rustdoc gate run. Both docs.rs and the existing CI doc job will reject the next release of jmap-chat-client until fixed.
title: P1: cargo doc --workspace fails — unclosed HTML tag T in jmap-chat-client//! Patch<T>
